propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI.
FastMCP derives JSON schemas from handwritten callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before the adapter runs, making these parameters unreachable over MCP.
The MCP adapter forwarding layer only passes close_class or assignee to the library, dropping other parameters even if declared in signatures.
MCP caused_by, ref, and force must be exposed in signatures and forwarded unchanged to the existing library core to achieve parity with CLI/library surfaces.
The merged fix exposes transition_ticket force (str | None), caused_by, and ref; exposes claim_ticket force (str | None); and delegates all parameters to rebar.transition and rebar.claim.
